title: German Beef Hash
description: A hearty German-inspired dish made with beef, potatoes, and onions.

ingredients.name: beef broth
ingredients.notes: you can use store-bought beef broth or make your own

instructions: 1. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet and swirl it around to coat the bottom.
3. Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until it's translucent, about 5 minutes.
4. Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and cook for about 5 minutes, or until they start to brown.
5. Add the ground beef to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
6. Cook the beef until it's browned, about 5-7 minutes.
7. Add the hash browns to the skillet and stir to combine with the beef and potatoes.
8. Cook for about 5 minutes, or until the hash browns are crispy and golden brown.
9. Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper as needed.
10. Serve the German Beef Hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
